title: Argylle
edition: 2024 theatrical feature directed by Matthew Vaughn
synopsis: Novelist Elly Conway is attacked on a train when her fiction proves unexpectedly close to an intelligence operation. Aiden gets her and her cat out alive.
verdictRationale: Aiden’s most generous act is listening closely enough to help Elly name her fear. The story values her kindness even as she becomes more capable under pressure. Its elaborate fights, however, make the deaths of anonymous opponents feel like the punch line of a joke.
ageRationale: The train ambush and later extended fights put Elly in peril. Comic timing and limited wound detail soften the images, but repeated killings, coarse language and suggestive dancing warrant guidance for younger teens.
reflection: Aiden can fight the people pursuing Elly. He cannot take a frightening flight for her. On that occasion love takes the quieter form of staying beside someone who is afraid.

themes.name: Encouragement
themes.evidence: Aiden helps Elly through immediate danger and later shares his own fear of heights. His continuing care gives her room to act.

themes.name: Kindness
themes.evidence: When Elly’s skills change, Aiden singles out the kindness he already valued in her. This becomes an explicit standard for judging her growth.

themes.name: Violence as entertainment
themes.evidence: The attackers on the train pose a real threat. Later, choreographed blows and kills recur as visual jokes, drawing attention away from the people being hurt.

themes.name: LGBTQ Themes & Messaging
themes.evidence: A remark between two women refers to a shared past. The reviewer offers several readings. Check the scene and surrounding dialogue before identifying the relationship or scoring its prominence.

questions: When Elly panics on the plane, what does Aiden’s climbing story give her that an order to calm down would miss?

title: Kraven the Hunter
edition: 2024 theatrical feature directed by J. C. Chandor
synopsis: After a lion mauls young Sergei, Calypso saves him. As an adult he hunts criminals and searches for his kidnapped half-brother Dmitri.
verdictRationale: Dmitri’s forgiveness repairs something Sergei could never put right by force. Calypso likewise saves a stranger before knowing what he will become. Yet the action repeatedly presents Sergei’s power to decide who dies as the satisfying answer to injustice. His rejection of his father’s criminal business leaves his father’s habit of domination intact.
ageRationale: Adult guidance reflects repeated graphic killings, a mauling and the sight of people injured in traps. The intimacy of a father pressuring his sons and the threat of losing a brother add distress beyond the combat.
reflection: Sergei can rescue Dmitri from captors, but the years Dmitri spent alone with their father call for a different response. Dmitri offers forgiveness freely. Consider what accepting that gift could ask Sergei to change.

themes.name: Brotherly loyalty
themes.evidence: Annual birthday visits keep the brothers in touch. Dmitri’s abduction turns that bond into a sustained rescue effort.

themes.name: Mercy
themes.evidence: Calypso saves the wounded boy and Dmitri forgives his abandonment. These decisions restore life and relationship at distinct turning points.

themes.name: Vigilantism
themes.evidence: Sergei makes hunting criminals his vocation. Calypso questions his methods, but the film repeatedly uses his killings as heroic payoffs.

themes.name: Parental coercion
themes.evidence: Nikolai’s lion hunt pressures Sergei to prove himself. The father’s favoritism continues to divide the brothers into adulthood.

themes.name: LGBTQ Themes & Messaging
themes.evidence: The reviewed sources discuss Nikolai’s affair and the brothers’ family history. They do not give enough information to score LGBTQ prominence. Screen the 2024 theatrical cut and record relevant dialogue and context.
